0022600042.text: The Thunder (8-4) are third in the Northwest, half a game back, and seventh in the West, having lost their last two while going 6-4 over their last ten and 5-0 at home. They face a Clippers team that is 2-8, 4th in the Pacific and 7.5 games back, 13th in the West, and 0-5 on the road. Oklahoma City is missing Ajay Mitchell (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while the Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery), and Cam Christie is day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision. The Thunder lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 108-101 win in Oklahoma City, and they also won 3-0 against the Clippers in 2025-26.
